toc.title: hasOne<TypeParameter T, TypeParameter ForeignKeyName>(entityBuilder, options): HasOneWithForeignKey<T, ForeignKeyName>

blocks.text: hasOne<TypeParameter T, TypeParameter ForeignKeyName>(entityBuilder, options): HasOneWithForeignKey<T, ForeignKeyName>

blocks.html:
This method defines a relationship between two data models,
where the owner of the relationship has one record of the related
data model.

For example: A user "hasOne" email.

Use the [belongsTo](/references/data-model/relationship-methods/belongsto) method to define the inverse of this relationship in
the other data model.

```ts
import { model } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

const User = model.define("user", {
  id: model.id(),
  email: model.hasOne(() => Email),
})
```

types.name: T
types.description:
The type of the entity builder passed as a first parameter. By default, it's
a function returning the related model.

types.name: entityBuilder
types.description: A function that returns the data model this model is related to.

children.name: mappedBy
children.description:
The name of the relationship as defined in the other
data model. This is only required by the `belongsTo` and `manyToMany`
relationship method.
